description: This file implements a templated animated class for handling frame-based animations, including methods for starting, updating, and retrieving animation frames and timing information.

classes.name: animated<T, T_void_value>
classes.description: A templated class managing frame-based animations, including timing, frame updates, and cycle control.

methods.name: animated(const std::string &cfg, const string_initializer& init)
methods.description: Constructor initializing animation frames from a configuration string.

methods.name: add_frame(int start)
methods.description: Adds a frame at a specific start time.

methods.name: add_frame(int start, const T& value)
methods.description: Adds a frame with a specific start time and value.

methods.name: start_animation(int start_frame, int cycles, int acceleration)
methods.description: Begins the animation with specified start frame, cycle count, and acceleration.

methods.name: update_current_frame_internal()
methods.description: Updates the current frame based on elapsed time and cycles.

methods.name: frame_changed()
methods.description: Returns whether the frame has changed since last update.

methods.name: animation_finished()
methods.description: Checks if the animation has finished.

methods.name: get_first_frame_time()
methods.description: Returns the time of the first frame.

methods.name: get_last_frame_time()
methods.description: Returns the time of the last frame.
